comment: CI shard map for the e2e job (parallel: 5). Each entry lists the feature FILES one shard runs (comma-separated, relative to the codecept dir, consumed via TASK_CODECEPTJS_FEATURES); check:shard-coverage enforces that every feature file lands in exactly one shard. Balanced on measured scenario durations: heavy single stories ride alone (1, 2), image-affine scenarios share a shard so the MegaLinter pull is paid once (5).
